newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady to firmer, active barge trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady to firmer, active barge trade.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady to a touch firmer on Thursday with barges actively trading.
On the key ARA barge market specific Rotterdam liftings continued to draw a premium over those with general ARA options as supplies there remain tight.
One Rotterdam refiner who has been covering all week was on the market again today paying up to $210 a tonne for Rotterdam refinery material but later sold barges at $211 fob Rotterdam.
Cargo demand across NWE remained thin with little interest to take product transatlantic and only light buying into Hamburg seen. Countering this offers of cargoes were scarce.
